content: {"kind":"plan","text":"按办公室场景只排了坐姿和站姿动作：先用坐姿猫牛式和骨盆画圈给脊柱、髋部「上油」，再做深蹲、坐姿抬膝和站姿侧抬腿练下肢与核心，最后用站姿侧屈放松腰侧。你没说目标，我按「缓解僵硬、轻活动」来排，强度按入门算，全程不用躺、不用跪、不用趴。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"办公室10分钟松僵","summary":"坐站姿活动脊柱髋部＋下肢轻力量＋腰侧拉伸，肩腰不加重负担","goal":"mobility","scene":"office","equipment":["chair"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":10,"avoid":["颈","肩","腰"],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"o-seated-catcow","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"n-pelvis-circle","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-squat","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":12,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"n-seated-knee-lift","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":20,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":20},{"exerciseId":"h-side-leg-raise","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":10,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":20}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"o-stand-sidebend","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]}],"notes":["你没说具体目标，按「缓解僵硬、轻活动」排；强度默认入门，时长用你给的 10 分钟。","办公室默认只有椅子和墙，全程未用躺、跪、趴体位。","主训练以下肢和核心为主，肩颈腰只做低负荷活动，没有安排负重推举和躯干旋转类动作。"],"safetyNotes":["动作全程保持呼吸，腰背不塌不憋气。","肩颈或腰的不适加重就立即停止；如果僵硬持续不缓解或出现麻木、放射痛，建议先咨询医生或康复师。"]}}
